_about: Which WoW Forever auction house belongs to which ruleset and faction. Blizzard's API lists every house under every ruleset, so this is mapped by hand: python tools/ah_prices.py match compares your own GoldScout scans with each house. Only add a house once a scan has matched it.

113.how: 2026-11-09: GoldScout scan on CAMWOWUS2Realm2PvP (Horde) matched 67% of lowest prices; no other house above 25%
